examPassDescription: Our students have maintained a high pass rate in German language examinations.
overview: Learn Language Education Academy has supported German learners since 2022 with structured teaching, assignments and exam preparation.

team.name: Felix Asadu
team.bio: German Language Instructor, founder of Learn Language Education Academy and founder/software developer of Falowen. He holds a degree in International Management from IUBH in Germany, a Goethe-Institut B2 German certificate, and a TEFL certificate in Teaching English as a Foreign Language.

team.name: Sabina Michel
team.bio: Sabina supports the academy's daily administrative activities, including student communication, email correspondence, enquiries, and coordination of academic information. She helps ensure students receive timely updates and assistance throughout their learning journey.

team.name: Dr. Ruth Ndekiro Shao
team.bio: Dr. Ruth Ndekiro Shao is a Kiswahili language instructor and researcher with over eight years of experience, including teaching at the University of Ghana and the University of Hamburg in Germany. She holds a PhD in Kiswahili from the University of Dar es Salaam and teaches learners from beginner to advanced levels. Her expertise spans linguistics, translation, second language acquisition, and curriculum development. She combines interactive digital tools with culturally rich, learner-centered teaching to help students communicate confidently in Kiswahili.
credentials: PhD in Kiswahili · University of Dar es Salaam
University of Ghana & University of Hamburg

team.name: Catherine Agbleze Etornam
team.bio: University of Ghana graduate in Philosophy with Political Science and holder of a Goethe A2 German certificate. She supports prospective and current students with enquiries, onboarding and academic guidance.
credentials: Philosophy with Political Science · University of Ghana

team.name: Hana
team.role: Consulting Agency Partner · Global Mobility Specialist & Education Advisor (Germany)
team.bio: Hana works with our team as a consulting agency partner. Based in Germany, she supports students and families with global mobility guidance, education pathways, and practical travel planning support.
